## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List checks performed and their results. Explain skipped checks and remaining limitations.
For pronunciation changes, include input and expected output.
For model comparisons, include checkpoint identity, configuration, seeds, data split, and metric settings.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read the contributing guidelines, code of conduct, and code of ethics.
- [ ] I checked the diff for secrets, private data, recordings, checkpoints, and generated artifacts.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute the included material and preserved applicable notices.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and considered accessibility.
- [ ] I described relevant validation or explained why it does not apply.

## Data, models, or accessibility impact

Describe provenance, consent, distribution terms, transcripts, or accessibility checks when relevant. Otherwise write "Not applicable".
